brief: Separate planned saving from money that is accidentally left over.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Plan saving explicitly"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Planea el ahorro explícitamente"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Planeje a poupança explicitamente"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Separate planned saving from money that is accidentally left over.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Give feasible saving a purpose and amount instead of assuming every remainder is free.
instruction.misconception: Calling an account balance saving without checking unpaid obligations or making a feasible allocation.
instruction.numeracy_support: The worked examples introduce the required operation; every assessed task retains its own amounts and assumptions.

evidence.reasoning: Planned saving has an amount and purpose within available money. An unexplained account remainder may still cover unpaid bills.
The purpose and feasible allocation make the saving intentional.
A balance may include money already needed for a bill.
A plan and a completed movement are different records.
Writing a target does not create funds for it.
A chosen feasible use makes this remainder part of the saving plan.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.
